title: Water for the Voyage
subtitle: Live class · Dimensionality reduction (PCA)
story: A voyaging canoe on the black sand at the mouth of Waipiʻo Valley sails on the evening tide, and the whole class is its water crew. Walk up the valley to a water source, run a PCA on its well chemistry (invented, but based on Hawaii's real aquifers) and answer from your own results to fill your gourds: one at the well, two at the stream, three at the spring under the falls. Carry each load back down to the canoe and load it; when the deck is full, the canoe sails.

sceneSpec.setting: the open black-sand beach at the mouth of Waipiʻo Valley, where the stream runs out to the sea between two immense green cliffs
sceneSpec.seam: a calm, even stretch of black sand running away along the beach to a line of gentle surf and the foot of the far cliff, plain and unbroken
sceneSpec.seamOccluder: one leaning hala tree on the sand, its prop roots splayed and its spiky leaves drooping

elements.desc: the left half of the calm view directly behind the viewer: black sand running away along the beach to gentle surf and the foot of the far cliff, joining its other half cleanly at the seam directly behind you
the shallow clear stream crossing the black sand beside the viewer in a wide fan of braided channels, running out into the surf; the viewer's side of it is dry sand

elements.label: The path up the valley
elements.desc: starting on the black sand under the viewer's feet and staying on this side of the stream, a well-trodden path crosses the sand to a wide gap in the line of ironwood trees at the back of the beach and runs on straight inland up the flat valley floor, past flooded green taro terraces, toward the head of the valley, where one tall waterfall drops the whole height of the cliff, far away

standing on the sand at the back of the beach, below the great cliff, a small plain blank board of dark koa wood with a pale carved border, on a single low post with a ring of white coral stones round its foot, its face bare, unlike anything else in the scene
elements.label: The valley walls
The path to the well
elements.desc: from the sand under the viewer, a narrow path runs level along the back of the beach to a shaded clearing in the line of ironwood and hala trees, where the low grey stone rim of a well shows on the sand

elements.label: The voyaging canoe
elements.desc: close to the viewer, both hulls resting flat on the same black sand, a compact Polynesian double-hulled voyaging canoe: two dark wooden hulls side by side, joined by crossbeams carrying a lashed wooden deck, a single mast stepped in the deck between the hulls with its crab-claw sail furled and lashed. The canoe lies BROADSIDE to the viewer, parallel to the back of the beach, its carved bows pointing LEFT toward the centre of the view and its sterns at the right. The whole canoe, bows and sterns alike, stands well in from the edge of the frame, with its sterns ending on open sand no more than three-quarters of the way from the centre of the view to the right edge. Between its sterns and that edge lies a wide stretch of open black sand and gentle surf, where low surf runs up the black sand and the water out past the cliff shadow is lit gold, with nothing else standing on it. On the deck a few round brown water gourds are lashed in a row, with clear room for many more. A broad cream pennant, as long as a person, flies from the masthead, rippling hard in the trade wind

motion.vigour: rippling hard in the trade wind
motion.phrase: the broad cream pennant at the top of the mast ripples and snakes out in the wind, waves running along it from the mast to its tip

sound.source: the pennant and the lashings in the wind
sound.character: a soft flutter and the creak of lashings

elements.desc: the right half of the calm view directly behind the viewer: black sand running away along the beach to gentle surf and the foot of the far cliff, joining its other half cleanly at the seam directly behind you

sceneSpec.soundBed: an open windward beach: a steady trade wind off the sea and the long roar of surf on sand.
sceneSpec.rigid: the canoe's hulls, deck, mast and furled sail, the gourds, the trees, the cliffs, the plaque
sceneSpec.atmosphere: an open, salt-hazed beach, the sea out past the cliff shadow lit gold under a few small white trade-wind clouds, painterly realism, the sense of a crossing about to begin
sceneSpec.styleLight: late afternoon, about an hour before sunset: the sun has dropped behind the high cliffs at the head of the valley, so the valley floor and the beach lie in soft, cool, luminous shade, while warm gold light still falls high on the upper cliff faces against a clear deep-blue sky
sceneSpec.negatives: No people, no figures, no lettering, signs or text anywhere (the one plain blank wooden plaque board, where described, carries no marks). Nothing modern: no pumps, pipes, concrete, fences, buildings, vehicles, power lines, roads or motorboats. No temple platforms, no graves or burial markers, no carved figures, no petroglyphs. The canoe rests ON the sand, not in the water and not floating; the paths start on the dry sand under the viewer and never cross the stream. Only ONE canoe. The outermost 184 px at each side edge show only open black sand, gentle surf, sea, the far cliff and sky, continuous across the join: no part of the canoe, its bows, its hulls, or its cast shadow enters either margin. The canoe's bows point toward the centre of the view, never toward the right edge; its sterns, bow tips, hulls and cast shadow all end at least 300 px short of the right edge (nothing of it beyond x = 2770 of 3072), leaving the outermost 184 px at each side as open black sand, surf, sea, far cliff and sky only. Between the canoe's sterns and the right edge of the frame there is nothing but open black sand, surf, sea, the far cliff and sky; the canoe, its hulls and its shadow stay wholly in the right-centre of the view. The right-hand tenth of the frame holds no part of the canoe, its sterns, hulls, crossbeams or cast shadow: only open black sand, gentle surf, sea, the far cliff and sky, continuing unbroken across the join into the outermost 184 px at the left edge.

world.joins: Here: the black-sand beach under the viewer, running level in every direction to the foot of the great cliffs; on the right, the double-hulled canoe sits on the same sand, its bows to the sea; ahead and a little to the right, a path runs level along the back of the beach to a clearing among the ironwood trees; ahead and a little to the left, a path leaves the sand through a gap in the ironwoods beside the stream and runs straight inland up the flat valley floor toward the waterfall at its head; on the left, the shallow stream crosses the sand to the sea.

sceneSpec.motionClosing: Only the pennant, the surf and the stream's water move; the canoe, the sand, the trees, the cliffs and the plaque stay exactly where they are.
